column1: The holovid from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreQuikscell],company]] headquarters flickers and jitters. A clearly synthesised female voice talks over an image of a speaking, smiling woman whose mouth is very obviously not making the words you hear. "Hello, valued Khan of Clan We here at the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} branch of the QUIKSCELL COMPANY thank you for your ERROR order of Clan equipment and your contract with us! As a token of our appreciation for your CBills and Patreonism contribution to the QUIKSCELL COMPANY, we are legally mandat-- thrilled --to reward you with a QUIKSCELL COMPANY CARE PACKAGE! Please enjoy your mandate-- Bonus --Command Mech Specially designed for your use!" Judging by the scrubber bar, the remaining two-thirds of the message are likely to be legalese. Probably safe to ignore it.
column2: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreQuikscell],company]]总部的全息影像闪烁、抖动。一个清晰合成的女性声音与一个正在说话、微笑的女人的图像进行对话，她的嘴显然没有说出你听到的话语。“您好，尊贵的部落可汗 我们在这里是 QUIKSCELL 公司的{TGT_SYSTEM.name}分公司，感谢您的支持错误部落装备订单以及您与我们签订的合同 为了感谢您对CBills 和 Patreonism对 QUIKSCELL 公司的贡献，我们合法地任务--兴奋--奖励您 QUIKSCELL 公司护理包 请享受您的任务--奖金--命令机甲 专为您设计！" 从清理栏来看，剩余三分之二的消息很可能是合法术语。忽略它可能是安全的。

column1: As you stride into the Mech Bay to inspect the newly arrived 'Command Mech' courtesy of Quicsell. Yang is already in action, his curses filling the air. He points at the mech, tapping the structure with his wrench, the sound echoing a hint of hollowness. "Commander... they drilled Holes... Holes!" he exclaims, frustration evident. "Sure, it's endosteel or something, but who saves weight by weakening the structure?" With a heavy sigh, he fixes you with a serious look. "If you decide not to scrap this mech, Commander, I'd tread cautiously. Thin armor, and we might just find ourselves in need of a new Khan for our little 'clan,' Commander."
column2: 当您大步走进机甲湾，检查奎塞尔提供的新抵达的“指挥机甲”时。 杨已经行动起来，咒骂声满天飞。他指着机甲，用扳手敲击结构，声音回荡着一丝空洞。 “指挥官……他们钻了洞……洞！”他惊呼道，语气中流露出明显的挫败感。 “当然，是内骨骼什么的，但是谁通过削弱结构来减轻重量呢？” 重重地叹了口气，用严肃的眼神定定你。 “如果你决定不报废这台机甲，指挥官，我会谨慎行事。薄薄的盔甲，我们可能会发现我们的小‘部落’需要一个新的可汗，指挥官。”

column1: Why did they remove an arm? WHY does the other arm only have a shoulder, and for some clownish reason a HAND bolted directly onto it!? That's not how arms work! Who approved this?! Who looked at this thing and thought, 'Yes, that's a perfectly reasonable weapons platform'?! And what did the pilot mean when he wrote 'I went to a Mapleton's and the coffee was bad' in the maintenance log? Is that supposed to be a warning? A distress signal? Some kind of Quicsell corporate code? I'm not investigating this anymore
column2: 他们为什么要去掉一只手臂？为什么另一只手臂只有肩膀，并且出于某种滑稽的原因，一只手直接固定在上面！？武器不是这样工作的！谁批准了这个？！谁看着这个东西并想，“是的，这是一个完全合理的武器平台”？！当飞行员在维护日志中写下“我去了 Mapleton 咖啡店，咖啡很糟糕”时，他的意思是什么？这应该是一个警告吗？求救信号？某种 Quicsell 公司代码？我不再调查这个了

column1: Gotta go fast? We here at Quicksell have you covered with the blazing Blue Flame. Faster than even most light 'Mechs, the only thing that can outrun it is our Blue Hedgehog. Knowing that speedy 'Mechs often have issues tracking targets, we've packed a pair of LBX Lasers into the turret, providing a solid chance of connecting with any target you can see on the screen. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 一定要快点吗？我们 Quicksell 为您提供了闪亮的蓝色火焰。比大多数轻型机甲还要快，唯一能超越它的是我们的蓝色刺猬。我们知道快速的机甲经常在跟踪目标时遇到问题，因此我们在炮塔中安装了一对 LBX 激光器，为您在屏幕上看到的任何目标提供了可靠的连接机会。特质：稳定武器掉落成本乘数：1.03

column1: The Blue Flame began production after the Word of Blake took possession of Terra. The same factory that had produced the Shootist was upgraded to produce four legged BattleMechs. The Blue Flame is an extremely stable platform due to its quadrupedal configuration. In the later years of the Jihad, an engineer who had helped build the 'Mech stole the design specs and later created the Thunder Fox.
column2: 布莱克之言占领泰拉后，蓝色火焰开始生产。生产射击者的同一家工厂升级为生产四足战斗机甲。由于其四足结构，蓝色火焰是一个极其稳定的平台。在圣战后期，一位帮助建造“机甲”的工程师窃取了设计规格，后来创造了雷狐。

column1: Quicksell knows pilots like fire, and is happy to provide. The BSW-QSK brings two of Quicksell's newest plasma-based weaponry, the Plasma Scattergun - guaranteed to melt any opposition, to the field. Targets still standing in that sea of flame? We've included a light mortar and REX Laser to help clean up anything remaining. Our classic Viewmaster Cockpit provides the widest field of view, ensuring pilots will become entranced by the wonders of the FLAME. Please do not use Quicksell equipment to found any sort of group that may result in stern letters being written to us. Yes - that includes an 'Extreme' S'mores Making Club. Please send us any s'mores though. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Quicksell 知道飞行员如火，并且很乐意提供。 BSW-QSK 带来了两种 Quicksell 最新的等离子武器，即等离子散射枪，保证能在战场上消灭任何对手。目标还站在那片火海里吗？我们配备了轻型迫击炮和 REX 激光机来帮助清理残留的任何东西。我们的经典 Viewmaster 驾驶舱提供了最广阔的视野，确保飞行员会被FLAME的奇迹所着迷。请不要使用Quicksell设备来建立任何可能导致我们收到严厉信件的团体。是的 - 其中包括“极限”夹心饼干制作俱乐部。请向我们发送任何 s'mores。特点：窄型/薄型部署费用倍率：1.05手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Boss, I know some people like fire, but this 'Mech is going too far. I swear the universe stuttered when we did a test run the other day. Anyway, you want to commit some ecological crimes, indulge your inner arsonist? *slap* This is the mech for it. You want to cross into potentially heretical stuff by calling it the "Burning Bushy", stare into the massive field of flames you ignited until they start talking to you. Well, Quicksell sells a kit to have the name engraved, and some totally-legit-not-hallucinogenic mushrooms. No, we're not ordering it. I already get enough hate-mail and bio-bombs because I called Blake a crummy engineer on that late night holoshow.
column2: 老板，我知道有些人喜欢火，但是这个‘机甲’太过分了。我发誓当我们前几天进行测试时，整个宇宙都结巴了。不管怎样，你想犯一些生态犯罪，放纵一下你内心的纵火犯吗？ *slap* 这就是它的机械装置。你想通过称之为“燃烧的浓密”来跨入潜在的异端事物，凝视着你点燃的巨大火焰场，直到他们开始与你交谈。好吧，Quicksell 出售一套刻有名字的工具包，以及一些完全合法的非致幻蘑菇。不，我们不订购。我已经收到了足够多的仇恨邮件和生物炸弹，因为我在那场深夜全息节目中称布莱克是一个糟糕的工程师。

column1: Yeah, Boss. This BusterHauler is really niche. Quicksell decided to focus on those smaller companies that needed 'Mechs, and offered something, well, reasonable. Great if you need something to move cargo or take on pirates with junk worse than you, but any BattleMech is going to be a difficult fight. Might be able to exploit that strength in carrying cargo for some weaponry, though.
column2: 是的，老板。这款 BusterHauler 确实很小众。 Quicksell 决定专注于那些需要“机甲”的小公司，并提供一些合理的东西。如果你需要一些东西来移动货物，或者用比你更糟糕的垃圾来对付海盗，那么这很好，但任何 BattleMech 都将是一场艰难的战斗。不过，也许能够利用这种优势来运送某些武器的货物。

column1: Oh boy, Boss. Quicksell really pushed the limits with their ad copy. Yeah, it has a Thumper Cannon, but the Long Tom is a one-shot, and the mortar just comes with flares. Not a bad idea if you needed to do some stealth ops while masquerading as workers, but anything else and you'll be wishing for more ammo, armor, and speed.
column2: 噢，老大。 Quicksell 的广告文案确实突破了极限。是的，它有一门重击炮，但长汤姆炮是一次性的，而且迫击炮只带有照明弹。如果你需要伪装成工人进行一些秘密行动，这不是一个坏主意，但如果你需要更多的弹药、装甲和速度，那么你会希望有更多的弹药、装甲和速度。

column1: Hey, for once Quicksell actually made a respectable 'Mech, Boss. Sure, the armor is low, and the movement is just faster than an Urbie, but that damage output is pretty good and it's relatively cheap. All we'd need to do is save some weight, up the armor, and it should be good in smaller battles.
column2: 嘿，这一次，Quicksell 实际上制造了一个令人尊敬的“机甲，老板”。当然，护甲较低，移动速度也比 Urbie 快，但伤害输出相当不错，而且相对便宜。我们需要做的就是减轻一些重量，增加装甲，这在较小的战斗中应该会很好。

column1: Hey Boss, looks like Quicksell finally saw what others were doing with their 'Mechs and decided to do it themselves. It'll wreck anything that gets to close, but getting to that range will be a pain. Good for urban combat though, where you can break line of sight and sneak up, but if you're caught without cover at range, even an AC/2 will ruin your day.
column2: 嘿，老板，看起来 Quicksell 终于看到了其他人用他们的“机甲”所做的事情，并决定自己做。它会破坏任何接近的东西，但达到这个范围将是一个痛苦。不过，它非常适合城市战斗，你可以突破视线并潜行，但如果你在远距离没有掩体的情况下被发现，即使是 AC/2 也会毁了你的一天。

column1: Yeah, the product of legal threats. Quicksell got into trouble after a few news reports showcasing the BusterHauler being, well, a deathtrap in close range combat. Faced with the losses from people demanding refunds or canceling orders, and still having a ton of BusterHauler frames, they developed a 5th model focused on long range combat with more than a few reloads of ammo. A few puff pieces later, and the BC-QSA5 was seen as a respectable long-range fire support for logistics companies.
column2: 是的，法律威胁的产物。在一些新闻报道显示 BusterHauler 在近距离战斗中是一个死亡陷阱后，Quicksell 陷入了麻烦。面对人们要求退款或取消订单造成的损失，并且仍然拥有大量 BusterHauler 框架，他们开发了第五种型号，专注于远程战斗，需要多次重新装填弹药。经过几场试验后，BC-QSA5 被视为后勤公司值得尊敬的远程火力支援。

column1: At Quicksell we always try to innovate. To that end, we proudly announce the CPLT-QSK! Designed to protect your assets from hostile missiles, our patented Laser AMS is the star of the show here! But that's not all! With the flip of a switch, the Laser AMS can be turned into a regular laser! Perfect for if anything slipped in under the radar. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 在 Quicksell，我们始终努力创新。为此，我们自豪地宣布 CPLT-QSK！我们的专利激光 AMS 旨在保护您的资产免受敌方导弹的攻击，是本次展会的明星！但这还不是全部！只需轻按开关，激光 AMS 就可以变成普通激光器！如果有什么东西在雷达下溜进来的话，这是完美的选择。特质：改进的干扰器部署费用倍率：1.07手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: You know, I'll never not be surprised by those guys at Quikscell - er ... Quicksell, or whatever they're called today. Who puts mortars where the missile bays should be? Their bootleg 'OmniMechs' are getting worse, I tell ya'. Well, at least it should shoot some missiles down, Boss.
column2: 你知道，我永远不会对 Quikscell 的那些人感到惊讶——呃……Quicksell，或者无论他们今天被称为什么。谁把迫击炮放在导弹舱应该在的地方？我告诉你，他们的盗版“OmniMechs”正在变得越来越糟。好吧，至少它应该击落一些导弹，老大。

column1: The Solaris Circuit, who doesn't want to test their metal and piloting skills in these high stakes, high win environments? You want to contend but can't afford a top of the line custom machine? Look no further then our new line of Gladiatorial Centurion series! Built with inspiration from ancient Terran Gladiators do these custom frames come with a bountifull mix of defences, melee weaponry and patented Quicsell weaponry of great renown and limited run. We heard our customers concerns on survivability and built these machines to take damage as good as they deal it. Feel like a hero of olden days with these marvelous melds of machine and muscle. All winnings earned while piloting these machines pay an exposure fee of 5% to Quicsell Industries, Solaris branch Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 索拉里斯赛道，谁不想在这些高风险、高胜利的环境中测试自己的金属和驾驶技能呢？您想要竞争但买不起顶级定制机器吗？别再犹豫了，我们的新系列角斗士百夫长系列！这些定制框架的灵感来自古代人族角斗士，配备了防御、近战武器和享有盛誉且限量运行的专利 Quicsell 武器的丰富组合。我们听到了客户对生存能力的担忧，并建造了这些机器来承受损坏和处理损坏。机器与肌肉的奇妙融合，让您感觉自己像昔日的英雄。驾驶这些机器时获得的所有奖金均需向 Quicsell Industries、Solaris 分公司支付 5% 的曝光费特质：易于驾驶部署费用倍率：1.04手手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Centurion is a venerable workhorse known for it's dependable service, weaponry and shield arm. This thing isn't a Centurion, not even close. Sure for Quicsell junk these might actually not break open after one hit but who let them even sell these things? I'm at a loss of words here boss. If you are looking for me I will be contemplating taking a walk outside the Argo without an Environmental suit on.
column2: 百夫长是一款值得尊敬的主力，以其可靠的服务、武器和盾臂而闻名。这东西不是百夫长，甚至不是百夫长。当然，对于 Quicsell 垃圾来说，这些东西实际上可能不会在一次点击后打开，但谁让他们甚至出售这些东西呢？老板我在这里无言以对。如果你在找我，我会考虑不穿环保服在阿尔戈号外面散步。

column1: Weighing in at 10 tons each, the ultralight Corgi Squad makes use of all the weight-saving technology available to the Clans. Each unit mounts a custom 100-rated extralight fusion engine capable of speeds of up to 160km/h and an endo steel frame, saving weight for ten standard heat sinks. The squad's offensive loadout is also fearsome given the individual 'Mech's light weight - collectively the squad operates a standard size clan LB 20-X autocannon, with two additional one-shot ATM-3 launchers available for emergencies. Two tons of reloads for the LB 20-X ensure that the bark is certainly not worse than the bite. Woof woof! Quirk: Corgi Squad Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 超轻型柯基犬小队每只重 10 吨，利用了族群可用的所有减重技术。每个单元都安装了定制的 100 级超轻聚变发动机，速度可达 160 公里/小时，并配有内骨骼框架，可减轻 10 个标准散热器的重量。考虑到单兵机甲的重量较轻，该小队的进攻负荷也很可怕 - 该小队集体操作一门标准尺寸的氏族 LB 20-X 自动加农炮，并有两个额外的一次性 ATM-3 发射器可用于紧急情况。 LB 20-X 的两吨重装弹确保了吠叫肯定不会比咬伤更糟糕。汪汪！特质：柯基小队部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: Woof woof? I ... yeah, no. I don't have words for this. Is that an LB 20-X they're pushing around? What do you mean it's Clan spec?!
column2: “汪汪？”我……是的，不。我对此无话可说。他们正在推的那是 LB 20-X 吗？部落规格是什么意思？！

column1: Personal ride of MechWarrior Pembroke, one of the youngest members of Clan Spaniel. Pembroke had a reputation as a brash and scrappy warrior and was most well known for chasing retreating Five Evil Monkey Tribe 'Mechs and herding them back to face honorable combat. To aid her in her task, her Corgi, the Cardigan, was extensively modified - mounting Five Monkey active probes to allow her to showcase the superiority of Clan technology. Though she hoped to prove she had what it takes to become Khan, her tactics attracted the attention of the Five Monkey Tribes, who would send hunter-killer Flea units after her. Quirk: Corgi Squad Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 机甲战士彭布罗克 (MechWarrior Pembroke) 的私人骑行，他是西班牙猎犬家族最年轻的成员之一。彭布罗克以傲慢而斗志旺盛的战士而闻名，最出名的是追赶撤退的五猴部落机甲并将他们赶回来进行光荣的战斗。为了帮助她完成任务，她的柯基犬“羊毛衫”经过了广泛的改造——安装了五只猴子主动探针，让她能够展示族群技术的优越性。尽管她希望证明自己有能力成为可汗，但她的策略引起了五猴部落的注意，他们派出了猎杀跳蚤部队追捕她。特质：柯基小队部署费用倍率：1.03

Pembroke had a reputation as a brash and scrappy warrior and was most well known for chasing retreating Five Evil Monkey Tribe 'Mechs and herding them back to face honorable combat. To aid her in her task, her Corgi, the Cardigan, was extensively modified - mounting Five Monkey active probes to allow her to showcase the superiority of Clan technology. column1: Ever wanted one of those fancy Fafnir from Defiance Industries, but couldn't afford one? We've got you covered! Loaded with plenty of top-of-the-range firepower: triple rotary rifles, and five - yes, five! - REX lasers! Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 您是否曾经想要一件来自 Defiance Industries 的精美法夫纳，但却买不起？我们为您服务！配备了大量的顶级火力：三联旋转步枪，还有五支——是的，五支！ - REX 激光器！特质：稳定武器掉落成本乘数：1.18手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: I'm not sure how Quikscell - uh... - Quicksell got hold of the blueprints for this one, Boss. They sure did load this thing full of junk. Are those rifles rotary? Well... if they hit, they should do some damage, Commander.
column2: 我不确定 Quikscell - 呃... -Quicksell是如何掌握这个的蓝图的，老板。他们确实装满了垃圾。那些步枪是旋转式的吗？嗯……如果他们击中的话，应该会造成一些伤害，指挥官。

column1: Rev up, Mech fans! The Quicsell Hunchback QSK is the dream machine you've been waiting for – packing a double AC/20 punch and speedy legs for a chase that'll leave your foes in the dust. With the ViewMaster cockpit and top-notch sensors, you'll be hitting your targets with pinpoint precision. Stay nimble with advanced compact X4 arm actuators, 5 extra double heatsinks, and 3 tons of ammo – because running out of bullets mid-battle is so last season. This isn't just a Mech; it's your ticket to MechWarrior stardom. Cruise into victory with style – the road to glory starts here! Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 机甲迷们，加油吧！ Quicsell Hunchback QSK 是您一直在等待的梦想机器 - 配备双 AC/20 拳头和快速的腿部，可将您的敌人远远甩在身后。借助 ViewMaster 驾驶舱和一流的传感器，您将能够精确地击中目标。借助先进的紧凑型 X4 手臂执行器、5 个额外的双散热器和 3 吨弹药来保持敏捷 - 因为上个赛季在战斗中子弹就耗尽了。这不仅仅是一个机甲；这是您成为《机甲战士》明星的门票。优雅地走向胜利——荣耀之路从这里开始！特质：战斗拳头掉落成本乘数：1.02

column1: Boss, they're hyping up this Quicsell Hunchback QSK with double AC/20s and speedy legs, but those 'advanced compact X4 arm actuators'? You'd practically miss every shot – like handing someone a sledgehammer for darts. And those speedy legs? The Mech might tip over if someone sneezes. It's all flashy promises, but I'd tread lightly. This Mech could be more spectacle than powerhouse on the battlefield.
column2: 老板，他们正在大肆宣传这款带有双 AC/20 和快速腿的 Quicsell Hunchback QSK，但是那些“先进的紧凑型 X4 臂执行器”呢？你几乎会错过每一次射击——就像递给某人一把用来飞镖的大锤一样。还有那些快速的腿？如果有人打喷嚏，机甲可能会翻倒。这些都是华而不实的承诺，但我会小心行事。这台机甲在战场上比强者还要壮观。

column1: Weighing in at 30 tons each, the Incorgnito expands upon QuickSell's 'Clan Corgi' lineup, introducing a specialised unit for electronic warfare operations. Utilising the latest in QuikSell technology, the Incorgnito carries a variety of weight saving and electronic warfare equipment to support lances of Corgies while they move into biting range,all the while providing laser and missile support against aerial targets. Protect your Corgies with Incorgnito Pet Insurance today!! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Incorgnito 每台重 30 吨，它扩展了 QuickSell 的“Clan Corgi”系列，引入了用于电子战行动的专用装置。 Incorgnito 采用最新的 QuikSell 技术，携带各种减重和电子战设备，在柯基犬进入咬合范围时为其提供长矛支持，同时为空中目标提供激光和导弹支持。立即购买 Incorgnito 宠物保险来保护您的柯基犬！！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：0.99手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Boss, its an Anubis I dont care what the ID says when you scan it, it looks like an Anubus. Commander, they even scratched off the ID tags and painted the word INCORGNITO poorly over it. What the hell is Clan Corgi? some sort of cult?
column2: 老板，这是一个阿努比斯，我不在乎你扫描它时ID上写着什么，它看起来就像一个阿努比斯。指挥官，他们甚至把身份标签都刮掉了，在上面涂了很糟糕的“INCORGNITO”字样。柯基氏族到底是什么？某种邪教？

column1: Rev your excitement with the Quicsell Incubus! Lighter than your ex's potato salad and armed to impress, this battle-scarred beauty comes with an extralight structure for agile maneuvers. Act fast on this limited-time offer – hotter than a flamethrower and priced to make your wallet smile. Test pilots welcome for a thrilling ride into MechWarrior history with the Quicsell Incubus – where every Mech has a story, and yours starts now! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 使用 Quicsell Incubus 激发您的兴奋！比你前任的土豆沙拉还要轻，而且武装得令人印象深刻，这个饱经战火的美女拥有超轻的结构，可以灵活机动。赶快行动吧，享受这个限时优惠——比火焰喷射器更热，而且价格实惠。欢迎试飞员乘坐 Quicsell Incubus 踏上机甲战士历史的惊心动魄旅程 - 每个机甲都有一个故事，而您的故事现在就开始！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Boss, that Quicsell Incubus? It's all flash and no substance. The extralight structure screams 'cheap,' and the firepower is just a distraction from the flimsy internals. Limited-time offer? Classic sales trick. I'd pass on this one if you're looking for a Mech that'll last longer than a firecracker's pop.
column2: 老大，那个Quicsell Incubus？一切都是闪光，没有实质内容。超轻的结构尖叫着“便宜”，而火力只是分散了脆弱的内部结构的注意力。限时优惠？经典的销售技巧。如果你正在寻找一种比鞭炮爆炸更持久的机甲，我会放弃这个。

column1: Introducing the Quicsell Locust – Unmatched Agility, Unrivaled Firepower! With a specially lightened structure for supreme agility, this variant carries two sets of Quicsell's pulse lasers and two heavy small chemical lasers for high stopping power. Topping it off is Quicsell's ViewMaster cockpit for the best view of the battle. The Quicsell Locust: Where agility meets firepower in style! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell Locust – 无与伦比的敏捷性、无与伦比的火力！该型号采用特殊的轻量化结构，具有极高的灵活性，携带两组 Quicsell 脉冲激光器和两个重型小型化学激光器，具有高阻止能力。最重要的是 Quicsell 的 ViewMaster 驾驶舱，可提供最佳的战斗视野。 Quicsell Locust：敏捷与火力的完美结合！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：0.95手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Boss, they're pushing the Quicsell Locust – agility, firepower, and some fancy cockpit view. I'm not buying the 'specially lightened' structure bit; sounds like they're hiding something. Flashy promises, but I'd approach it cautiously – could be more trouble than it's worth in the heat of battle.
column2: 老板，他们正在推动 Quicsell Locust——敏捷性、火力和一些奇特的驾驶舱视图。我不买“特别轻”的结构钻头；听起来他们好像在隐瞒什么。华而不实的承诺，但我会谨慎对待它——在激烈的战斗中可能会带来更多的麻烦。

column1: Celebrate Pride Month with your favorite military-industrial corporation, Quicksell! Show how pride your community with the LGB-TQ! Love is Love, and Love Wins with twin LGBTPPCs and everyone's favorite Disco Laser! .1% of every sale goes to charity! Always remember LGBTQuikSell!* *Not made for warzones, designed to only be used when nobdy is around ,contents may explode. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 与您最喜爱的军工公司 Quicksell 一起庆祝骄傲月！展示您的社区对 LGB-TQ 的自豪感！爱就是爱，爱赢了双胞胎 LGBTPC 和每个人最喜欢的迪斯科激光！每笔销售额的 0.1% 捐献给慈善机构！永远记住 LGBTQuikSell！**不是为战区而设计，仅在无人在场时使用，内容可能会爆炸。特质：精确武器 - 能量部署费用倍率：1.13手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Introducing the Quicsell Marauder MAD-QSK! This mech is hotter than Solaris VII in summer. Packed with an LBX PPC, scatter plas, ultralight rotary rifle, and chem lasers to spice up the battlefield. Need a Clanner repellent? We've got double AC/2s in each leg! And don't forget the Viewmaster cockpit – enjoy the chaos in 3D. Unleash the madness on your foes – grab yours now before they vanish like hotcakes! Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell Marauder MAD-QSK！这个机甲在夏天比Solaris VII还要热。配有 LBX PPC、散射塑料、超轻型旋转步枪和化学激光器，为战场增添趣味。需要族群驱虫剂吗？我们每条腿都有双 AC/2！不要忘记 Viewmaster 驾驶舱 - 享受 3D 的混乱。向你的敌人释放疯狂——在他们像烤饼一样消失之前抓住你的！特点：窄型/薄型部署费用倍率：1.11手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Quicsell's MAD-QSK Marauder: an eclectic circus show of weapons—LBX PPC, scatter plas, rotary rifle, chem lasers, and AC/2s in the legs. With a Viewmaster cockpit, it's an entertaining act, but for combat? I'd tread carefully if you're tempted to join this mech's act.
column2: Quicsell 的 MAD-QSK 掠夺者：不拘一格的马戏团武器表演——LBX PPC、散布塑料、旋转步枪、化学激光器和腿部的 AC/2。有了 Viewmaster 驾驶舱，这是一种有趣的行为，但是对于战斗呢？如果你想加入这个机甲的行列，我会小心行事。

column1: Ever wanted more Gauss? We here at QuicSell aim to please, and destroy our targets, with the new NSR-QSXL! Mounting not one, not two, not three, but four! brand new QS-limited-production-run Gauss weapons! You get your Ultra Gauss EX: perfect to scratch that Ultra itch, it's doubling down on the Gauss for those of you that love accuracy through volume of fire. And, the piece-de-resistance: Gauss Fingers! Everyone loves flipping the bird to your enemy, now you can slap them with it! Kill them with our Gauss Fingers, send in the BattleROM footage, and get a commemorative plate sent to you, or your next-of-kin! Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 想要更多高斯吗？我们 QuicSell 的目标是通过新的 NSR-QSXL 来取悦并摧毁我们的目标！安装不是一个，不是两个，不是三个，而是四个！全新QS限量生产高斯武器！您将获得 Ultra Gauss EX：非常适合消除 Ultra 痒感，对于那些喜欢通过火力来提高准确性的人来说，它的高斯值加倍。还有，最有力的武器：高斯手指！每个人都喜欢把小鸟扔给敌人，现在你可以用它来扇他们一巴掌！用我们的高斯手指杀死他们，发送 BattleROM 片段，并将纪念牌发送给您或您的近亲！特质：指挥机甲部署费用倍率：1.15手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Ever wanted more Gauss? We here at QuicSell aim to please, and destroy our targets, with the new NSR-QSXL! Mounting not one, not two, not three, but four! brand new QS-limited-production-run Gauss weapons! You get your Ultra Gauss EX: perfect to scratch that Ultra itch, it's doubling down on the Gauss for those of you that love accuracy through volume of fire. And, the piece-de-resistance: Gauss Fingers! Everyone loves flipping the bird to your enemy, now you can slap them with it! Kill them with our Gauss Fingers, send in the BattleROM footage, and get a commemorative plate sent to you, or your next-of-kin!
column2: 想要更多高斯吗？我们 QuicSell 的目标是通过新的 NSR-QSXL 来取悦并摧毁我们的目标！安装不是一个，不是两个，不是三个，而是四个！全新QS限量生产高斯武器！您将获得 Ultra Gauss EX：非常适合消除 Ultra 痒感，对于那些喜欢通过火力来提高准确性的人来说，它的高斯值加倍。还有，最有力的武器：高斯手指！每个人都喜欢把小鸟扔给敌人，现在你可以用它来扇他们一巴掌！用我们的高斯手指杀死他们，发送 BattleROM 片段，并将纪念牌发送给您或您的近亲！

column1: Presenting the Quicsell Nova M – Feel the Heat, No Breaks Required! This upgraded Mech boasts a swarm of standard chem lasers, delivering relentless firepower without the hassles of overheating. Quicsell brings you a Mech that thrives on the heat, ensuring more firing and zero downtime. The Nova M: turning up the battlefield intensity without missing a beat! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 推出 Quicsell Nova M – 感受热量，无需休息！这款升级后的机甲拥有大量标准化学激光器，可提供无情的火力，而不会出现过热的麻烦。 Quicsell 为您带来一款能够在高温下茁壮成长的机甲，确保更多的射击和零停机时间。 Nova M：毫不犹豫地调高战场强度！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：1.04手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Boss, this Quicsell Nova boasts more lasers, no overheating, but they conveniently forget the limited chemical ammo. It's like a fireworks show that might fizzle when the chemicals run dry. Approach with caution – flashy promises, not enough substance.
column2: 老板，这个 Quicsell Nova 拥有更多的激光，不会过热，但他们很容易忘记有限的化学弹药。这就像一场烟花表演，当化学物质耗尽时可能会失败。谨慎行事——承诺华而不实，实质内容不够。

column1: Introducing the Quicsell Nova S – Precision Unleashed! This Mech refines the game with heavy large chem lasers for accuracy and upgraded actuators. Dialing down the laser count to two, it retains the same 'heat management feature' as its heavy medium chem laser counterpart. Quicsell presents a Mech that dances on the edge of precision and heat, ensuring each shot hits the mark. The Nova S: where accuracy meets controlled firepower. Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell Nova S – 精准释放！该机甲通过重型大型化学激光器提高了准确性并升级了执行器，从而完善了游戏。将激光器数量减少到两个，它保留了与重介质化学激光器相同的“热管理功能”。 Quicsell 展示了一款在精准和热度边缘翩翩起舞的机甲，确保每次射击都击中目标。 Nova S：精度与受控火力的结合。特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：1.04手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Boss, the Quicsell Nova S claims precision with upgraded actuators and heavy large chem lasers. But watch out for the 'heat management feature' – sounds more like a liability. Less lasers, more accuracy, but I'd tread carefully. Precision won't save you if the heat becomes a meltdown.
column2: 老板，Quicsell Nova S 声称拥有升级的执行器和重型大型化学激光器的精度。但请注意“热量管理功能”——听起来更像是一种负担。更少的激光，更高的准确性，但我会小心行事。如果热量变得熔化，精确度也救不了你。

column1: Presenting the Quicsell Nova – Unleash the Inferno, MechWarriors! Our cutting-edge Mech comes equipped with heavy chem lasers, delivering superior damage and cost-efficient heat management. But here's the thrill – the more you fire, the hotter it gets. It's not a flaw; it's a feature! Embrace the strategic challenge of managing your firepower, and you'll own the battlefield. The Quicsell Nova – where the heat is on, and victory is sweeter when you earn it! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 推出 Quicsell Nova – 释放地狱，机甲战士！我们的尖端机甲配备了重型化学激光器，可提供卓越的破坏力和经济高效的热管理。但令人兴奋的是——你开火越多，温度就越高。这不是一个缺陷；而是一个缺陷。这是一个功能！迎接管理火力的战略挑战，你将掌控战场。 Quicsell Nova——热火朝天，当你赢得胜利时，胜利会更加甜蜜！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：1.04手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Boss, Quicsell's Nova boasts heavy chem lasers for a fiery punch, but watch out – the more you fire, the hotter it gets. It's a risky game, and I'm not sold on the idea. Managing that kind of heat on the battlefield? It's like playing with fire, and I'm not one to bet against Murphy's Law.
column2: 老大，Quicsell 的 Nova 拥有重型化学激光器，可以产生猛烈的冲击力，但要小心 - 你发射的越多，它就会变得越热。这是一个有风险的游戏，我不认同这个想法。在战场上应对如此炎热的天气？这就像玩火一样，我不是一个反对墨菲定律的人。

column1: Introducing the Quicsell Piranha – Unleash the Bullet Tsunami! Get ready for a wild ride with 12MGs that each somehow spit out an extra round – because why settle for standard when you can have more? Our state-of-the-art extralight structure ensures unmatched agility, and, oh yeah, it's definitely not prone to jamming. The Piranha: where firepower meets finesse. Own the battlefield, Quicsell style! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: Quicsell Piranha 隆重登场 – 释放子弹海啸！准备好使用 12 枚机枪进行疯狂的骑行吧，每枚机枪都能以某种方式多发一轮——因为当您可以拥有更多时，为什么要满足于标准呢？我们最先进的超轻结构确保了无与伦比的灵活性，而且，哦，是的，它绝对不容易卡住。 Piranha：火力与技巧的结合。以奎塞尔风格掌控战场！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：0.95

column1: Boss, Quicsell's pitching the Piranha with 12MGs and a so-called 'jam-proof' guarantee. Smells fishy to me. Extra shots and no jams? I'll believe it when I see it. Might be more show than substance, so unless you're feeling lucky, I'd steer clear and stick with something proven on the battlefield.
column2: 老板，Quicsell 正在向 Piranha 投放 12 个机枪并提供所谓的“防堵塞”保证。我闻起来有鱼腥味。额外的镜头并且没有卡纸？当我看到它时我会相信它。可能更多是作秀而不是实质，所以除非你感觉幸运，否则我会避开并坚持使用在战场上经过验证的东西。

column1: We here at QuicSell saw the opportunity to make every Mechwarrior into royalty, with our new Queenbee LAM. Faster than those proletarian Bug 'Mechs, this Queenbee packs a powerful sting, with a pair of Medium Chem Lasers and a Small Chem laser, as well as a modest bomb bay. It may be modest, but packed in that bomb bay, your opportunity to 'Release the Hive!'(tm) with our Firecracker rockets. And if that's not enough, the Queenbee comes equipped with our classic Hardwood structure, enabling anyone to do structural repairs to their mech in even the worst technological conditions! Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 我们在 QuicSell 看到了通过我们的新 Queenbee LAM 让每一位机甲战士成为皇室成员的机会。这只蜂王比那些无产阶级的机械甲虫更快，它拥有强大的毒刺，配有一对中型化学激光器和一个小型化学激光器，以及一个适度的炸弹舱。它可能很不起眼，但装在炸弹舱里，让您有机会用我们的鞭炮火箭“释放蜂巢！”(tm)。如果这还不够，Queenbee 配备了我们经典的硬木结构，使任何人都可以在最恶劣的技术条件下对其机械进行结构维修！特质：陆空机甲部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: Quicksell presents the RFL-QSK, based off the RFL-1N we improved the weapon capacity and added our special LBX Large lasers, proven to allways hit your target at any range (at least once). Along the lines of solving the issues of heat that plague the Rifleman series we also added our Double Heatsinks and a Thermal Mass designed to soak up extra heat, Fire away Mechwarriors and enjoy the panaramic views offered by our ViewMaster Cockpit!* *Warning Cockpit may burn pilots upon mech overheating, running the redline is not reccomended. Cockpit window not designed to take fire avoid at all costs. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Quicksell 推出了 RFL-QSK，在 RFL-1N 的基础上，我们改进了武器能力，并添加了特殊的 LBX 大型激光器，经证明能够在任何距离击中目标（至少一次）。为了解决困扰 Rifleman 系列的散热问题，我们还添加了双散热器和热质量，旨在吸收多余的热量，驱散机甲战士并享受 ViewMaster 驾驶舱提供的全景视野！**警告驾驶舱可能会因机甲过热而烧伤飞行员，不建议运行红线。驾驶舱窗户的设计并非为了不惜一切代价避免火灾。特质：防空瞄准部署费用倍率：1.02手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Well It'll certainly run a little cooler than the stock model commander, just make sure you let those jockey's know not to run this thing too hot, or we'll end up serving them as 'Special Rare Meat' in the galley, dont even get me started on how dangerous that cockpit is commander.
column2: 好吧，它肯定会比库存模型指挥官运行得更凉爽，只要确保你让那些骑师知道不要让这东西运行得太热，否则我们最终会在厨房里将它们作为“特殊稀有肉”，甚至不要让我开始说驾驶舱是多么危险的指挥官。

column1: The Roughneck, hailing from humble beginnings as the Loader King, this Industrial mech turned Militarised workhorse has seen many a role. This specific model has come about after a former 'Notable' Solaris Arena gladiator fell on hard times. Trying to make ends meat they agreed to a sponsorship for Quicsells latest edition of their new and improved 'Quicsell Bargain battle Royale' . Packing some of the noteworthy Arena dominating Quicsell technologies does this specific version come with patented armor, a flexible TSM system and enough firepower to last a good battle. A roaring Quicsell Ultra AC 20 leads the charge backed up by their patented 'Streak' SRM launchers for accurate and conservative ammo usage. As customed to Roughneck loadouts it also brings two handheld disposable One Shot cannons for a finishing blow, then to be discarded. A small REX laser in the cockpit rounds out the armory in case of it's rather sparse ammo running out. But if the opposition isn't down by that point, it's on you soldier. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 粗颈者出身卑微，是装载机之王，这款由工业机械转变为军事化的主力，曾扮演过许多角色。这个特定的模型是在一位前“著名”索拉里斯竞技场角斗士陷入困境后诞生的。为了维持生计，他们同意赞助 Quicsells 最新版本的新改进的“Quicsell Bargain Battle Royale”。该特定版本采用了一些值得注意的 Arena 主导的 Quicsell 技术，并配备了专利装甲、灵活的 TSM 系统和足够的火力来持续一场精彩的战斗。咆哮的 Quicsell Ultra AC 20 在其获得专利的“Streak”SRM 发射器的支持下引领冲锋，实现准确而保守的弹药使用。按照钻头装备的习惯，它还携带两门手持式一次性一发大炮进行最后一击，然后将其丢弃。驾驶舱内的小型 REX 激光器使军械库更加完善，以防弹药耗尽。但如果到那时反对派还没有失败，那就是你的士兵了。特点：易于维护部署费用倍率：1.07

column1: I feel pity for the poor soul that had to turn a perfectly fine machine into this excuse for a working Battlemech. Sure it's not as faultily wired or skimps on the armor as much as some of their other gimmick models. Yes there is some severe firepower here but the drawbacks, the ammo consumption is horrible on these supposed 'Premium' launchers. And the cooling, this is meant for the Arena? How badly do you want the Pilot to sweat while risking their paycheck. All considered, could have been worse but I am not betting my personal stash of Scotch on this bucket of bolts anytime soon.
column2: 我为那些可怜的灵魂感到遗憾，他们不得不将一台完美的机器变成了一个工作战机的借口。当然，它不像其他一些噱头模型那样有错误的接线或在装甲上的吝啬。是的，这里有一些强大的火力，但缺点是，这些所谓的“高级”发射器的弹药消耗是可怕的。还有冷却，这是为竞技场准备的吗？你多么希望飞行员在冒着薪水风险的情况下流汗。综合考虑，情况可能会更糟，但我不会很快就把我个人收藏的苏格兰威士忌押在这桶螺栓上。

column1: Presenting the Quicsell Shadowhawk - a battlefield virtuoso! Engineered with a nimble, lightened structure, this mech boasts dual Quicsell Pulse Lasers, a thunderous double AC/5, and an extra Light Rifle for added punch. Sneaky and strategic, the Quicsell Special Streak SRM 4 hides beneath the compact cockpit, while the LRM 5 ensures a touch of finesse at a distance. Battle-tested and ready for action, this mech is your ticket to dominance. Own the battlefield with the Quicsell Shadowhawk – speed, firepower, and style in one lethal package! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell Shadowhawk - 战场大师！该机甲采用灵活、轻便的结构设计，拥有双 Quicsell 脉冲激光器、雷鸣般的双 AC/5 和额外的轻型步枪以增加打击力。 Quicsell Special Streak SRM 4 隐藏在紧凑的驾驶舱下方，狡猾且具有战略意义，而 LRM 5 则确保了远距离的技巧。经过战斗考验并准备好行动，这款机甲是您取得统治地位的门票。使用 Quicsell Shadowhawk 称霸战场——速度、火力和风格集于一身，致命一击！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: Well, great, it parades itself like an omnimech. But ask me to fix that? Don't bother. This supposed 'lightened structure' looks more like a shortcut than an advantage. Dual Quicsell Pulse Lasers might glitter, but I doubt they've got the substance. Double AC/5? Feels like compensating. Extra Light Rifle? Just trying too hard. And that 'secretive' Quicsell Special Streak SRM 4? Please. The LRM 5 is the icing on the cake – a mishmash without a plan. Battle scars or not, this Quicsell Shadowhawk won't earn my trust on the battlefield.
column2: 嗯，太棒了，它像一个全能机甲一样炫耀自己。但要求我解决这个问题？别打扰。这种所谓的“轻型结构”看起来更像是一种捷径，而不是一种优势。双 Quicsell 脉冲激光器可能会闪闪发光，但我怀疑它们是否有这种物质。双AC/5？感觉像是在补偿。超轻步枪？只是太努力了。还有那个“神秘的”Quicsell Special Streak SRM 4 吗？请。 LRM 5 是锦上添花——没有计划的大杂烩。不管是否有战斗伤痕，这把奎塞尔暗影鹰在战场上都不会赢得我的信任。

column1: Rev up, Mech Commanders! The Quicsell Shadowcat – the Commander's Dream Mech is here with upgraded sensors, a custom cockpit for that personalized touch, and a speedy pair of Quicsell legs. It's a firepower feast with two pulse lasers, an SRM 4, and four light MGs – like a sports car in the stars! We're tossing in those extra MGs for the same price – consider it a "bullet bonus"! Don't lead the charge without the Quicsell Shadowcat – your ticket to tactical stardom! Quirk: Quicksell Command Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 机甲指挥官们，加油吧！ Quicsell Shadowcat – 指挥官的梦想机甲配备了升级的传感器、可实现个性化触感的定制驾驶舱以及一双快速的 Quicsell 腿。这是一场由两门脉冲激光器、一门 SRM 4 和四门轻型机枪组成的火力盛宴——就像星空中的跑车！我们以相同的价格扔掉这些额外的 MG – 认为这是“子弹奖金”！如果没有 Quicsell Shadowcat，请不要带头冲锋——这是您成为战术明星的门票！特质：Quicsell指挥型氏族机甲部署费用倍率：1.03手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Boss, they're peddling this Quicsell Shadowcat – custom cockpit, speedy legs, the whole shebang. Looks fancy, but I'd bet my wrench those 'special features' come with a hefty price tag. And, did they say the Mech won't work without that custom cockpit? Sounds like a headache waiting to happen. Speedy legs or not, I'd tread carefully before jumping on the Quicsell bandwagon.
column2: 老板，他们正在兜售这款 Quicsell Shadowcat——定制的驾驶舱、快速的双腿，以及一切。看起来很花哨，但我敢打赌，这些“特殊功能”的价格标签很高。而且，他们是否说过没有定制驾驶舱，机甲就无法工作？听起来像是一个令人头痛的事情即将发生。无论腿是否快速，在加入 Quicsell 潮流之前我都会小心谨慎。

column1: Worried you don't have enough firepower on your support mechs?, have no fear! New from Quicksell Customs, the Stalker QSK!, Who needs to actually hit your target at long range when you can fire enough missiles to blot out the sun? Just in-case that wasnt enough we also included two of our exclusive SRM10 Launchers just for that 'go away and leave me alone' factor!* *Firing all weapons at once not recommended. Recent additions to the Ares conventions do not cover burning down entire forests just to kill a squad of Toads. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 担心你的支援机甲火力不够？别害怕！ Quicksell Customs 的新品，Stalker QSK！，当您可以发射足够遮蔽太阳的导弹时，谁需要真正远距离击中目标？以防万一这还不够，我们还包括两个独家 SRM10 发射器，只是为了“走开，别管我”！**不建议立即发射所有武器。阿瑞斯公约的最新补充内容并不包括仅仅为了杀死一队蟾蜍而烧毁整个森林。特质：战斗计算机部署费用倍率：1.15手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Celebrate the new year in style with our brand new Firecrackers!, replacing normal missiles we found that using non lethal fireworks we could fit one hundred of these things for air shows! Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 用我们全新的鞭炮来庆祝新年！取代普通导弹，我们发现使用非致命烟花，我们可以在航空表演中安装一百个这样的东西！特质：陆地航空机甲部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Whats to say about his mech, just another pointless custom design commander, who thought... fireworks were a great idea? Maybe you can find a good use for this mech
column2: 怎么说他的机甲，只是另一个毫无意义的定制设计指挥官，他认为……烟花是个好主意？也许你能找到这个机甲的好用处

column1: In this age of ECM and information warfare, you can't trust your sensors. But what can you trust? Your eyes. And here at QuicSell, we know just the thing for up-and-coming Mercs who are looking to make a name for themselves! With our Stormcrow model, your opponents will know they've picked the wrong battle from the moment they see you. Fielding the same* technology the Clans use, enjoy this Omnimech** in battle, and feel free to swap weapons out as you desire***. Worried about fancy Clan tech being too difficult for your maintenance crews? We've got that covered too, with easy-to-use tags and markings on all cabling. Remember folks, first impressions matter, and can decide the battle. Don't choose poorly, choose 'Clan QuickSell'(tm). Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 在这个 ECM 和信息战时代，您不能相信您的传感器。但你能相信什么？你的眼睛。在 QuicSell，我们知道那些希望为自己出名的崭露头角的雇佣兵的事情！借助我们的风暴鸦模型，您的对手从看到您的那一刻起就会知道他们选择了错误的战斗。部署与部落使用的相同*技术，在战斗中享受这台全能机甲**，并随意更换武器***。担心华丽的部落技术对您的维护人员来说太困难？我们也已经解决了这个问题，所有电缆上都带有易于使用的标签和标记。请记住，第一印象很重要，可以决定战斗。不要选择不好，选择“Clan QuickSell”(tm)。特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：1.05手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Tired of pesky Battle Armor ruining your day? Blast them away with our LBX PPCs! To that end we present the TLS-QS, designed to provide deterent with our custom LRM15 launchers designed not to hit your target with fancy sensors, but to blow up the ground they need to get to you! If that fails you can just burn nice little holes in they're fancy armor! Shoo little toads! Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 厌倦了讨厌的战斗装甲毁了你的一天吗？用我们的 LBX PPC 将它们炸飞！为此，我们推出了 TLS-QS，旨在通过我们定制的 LRM15 发射器提供威慑力，该发射器的设计不是用奇特的传感器击中您的目标，而是炸毁它们需要到达您身边的地面！如果失败了，你可以在它们精美的盔甲上烧一些漂亮的小孔！赶小蟾蜍！特点：易于试验部署费用倍率：1.04手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Well here's another case of slap on lots of weapons and worry about the heat later commander. I wonder if you can hit the side of a barn with that lrm launcher.
column2: 好吧，这是另一个使用大量武器并担心稍后指挥官的热度的情况。我想知道你是否可以用 lrm 发射器击中谷仓的一侧。

column1: Always wanted the iconic Clan Mad Cat, but worried about the technological issues with repairs? QuicSell is ecstatic to announce the Timber Cat for you Mercs with discerning tastes. Packing a pair of Streak PPCs, Medium REX lasers, and LRM 10s, you'll find yourself playing Clanner as you wipe opponents off the map. As for repairs, we here at QuicSell harken back to the Timber Cat's etymology, with our patented Clan Hardwood structure and wiring. So easy to repair, even the most inebriated inbred periphery mechanic can repair it. Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 一直想要标志性的疯狂猫家族，但又担心维修的技术问题？ QuicSell 欣喜地宣布为品味挑剔的雇佣兵推出木材猫。配备一对 Streak PPC、中型 REX 激光枪和 LRM 10，您会发现自己在玩 Clanner，将对手从地图上消灭。至于维修，我们 QuicSell 秉承 Timber Cat 的词源，采用我们获得专利的 Clan Hardwood 结构和布线。修理起来非常容易，即使是最醉的近亲外围机械师也能修理它。\\n特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：1.11手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Boss, this is a... Timber Cat? Is this wood? This IS wood! Who put wood into the structure? And are those decorative ears on the missile launchers? How does this not explode into fire when hot? How does that wood even survive the stresses of a mech? I can't believe QuicSell somehow developed some sort of magical wood that worked. And I have to order parts from them, can't replace it with stuff I find. Well, at least the weaponry is good. Those Streak PPCs are some of my favorite weapons, and the REX laser series is just exquisite.
column2: 老大，这是……木猫？这是木头吗？这是木头！谁将木材放入结构中？那些装饰性的耳朵是导弹发射器上的吗？这怎么能在热的时候不爆炸呢？那块木头是如何承受机甲的压力的呢？我不敢相信 QuicSell 不知何故开发出了某种有效的神奇木材。我必须从他们那里订购零件，不能用我找到的东西替换它。好吧，至少武器装备还是不错的。这些 Streak PPC 是我最喜欢的武器之一，REX 激光系列非常精致。

column1: With its focus on defense, the 'Mech is armed with very few weapons for an Medium. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 由于其重点是防御，“机甲”所配备的武器对于中型来说非常少。特质：改进的定位 - 短部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: How did we get hold of clantech you ask? Through totally legitimate means of course!* Included are our exclusive Micro REX lasers, designed to rip armor off mechs in seconds!** Also included are the latest in QS Jumpjet technology along with a specially designed PowerOverclocker! What does it do you ask? Makes the mech jump further and do more damage as it flies of course! *Allegations of stealing from clan steel viper are fabrications **Due to the tuning process Micro REX lasers do little damage to mech internals due to laser power falloff Quirk: Experimental Jumper Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 你问我们是怎么找到clantech的？当然是通过完全合法的手段！* 其中包括我们独有的 Micro REX 激光器，旨在在几秒钟内撕掉机甲的装甲！** 还包括最新的 QS Jumpjet 技术以及专门设计的 PowerOverclocker！你问它是什么？当然，让机甲跳得更远，飞行时造成更多伤害！*窃取氏族钢铁毒蛇的指控纯属捏造 **由于调谐过程，由于激光功率下降，Micro REX 激光器对机械内部几乎没有损坏特质：实验跳线部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: Everyone knows a LAM should just shoot and scoot, and here at QuicSell, we make that easy. Picking up a great deal on some Warhammer LAM parts, we decided to focus on an often ignored segment: periphery Heavy-LAM use. Knowing that you can't always find a machine shop, the Warhammer LAM QS comes with a patented hardwood frame originally seen on the 'Spruce Goose' WiGE, allowing even the most basic worlds to provide structural repair. Focusing on that initial impulse of damage, we've swapped out the dangerous ammo-laden missiles for everyone's favorite! Rockets! These are coupled with a pair of LBX PPC's to ensure better accuracy on strafing runs, as well as a modest bomb bay that we stock with even more rockets. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 每个人都知道 LAM 应该只是射击和滑行，而在 QuicSell，我们让这一切变得简单。在对一些战锤 LAM 部件进行了大量研究之后，我们决定将重点放在一个经常被忽视的部分：外围重型 LAM 的使用。知道你不可能总能找到机械车间，战锤 LAM QS 配备了最初在“Spruce Goose”WiGE 上看到的专利硬木框架，即使是最基本的世界也能提供结构修复。着眼于最初的伤害冲动，我们将危险的满载弹药的导弹换成了大家最喜欢的！火箭！它们与一对 LBX PPC 相结合，以确保扫射运行的准确性，以及一个适度的炸弹舱，我们可以存放更多火箭弹。特质：陆空机甲部署费用倍率：1.05手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Ever wanted to paint a whole area but dont want to use expensive time and money doing it the slow way? Enter the 'HotWings' Desinged to simply fly over the area you need 'painted' with our SupraSoakers exclusive to 'Hotwings' and select Quicksell outlets.* *Warning fluid emmitted by SupraSoaker may be flammable, do not subject to heat, Editors Note (Not For Public Viewing):PR Said it would sound cool. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 是否曾经想要粉刷整个区域，但又不想花费昂贵的时间和金钱以缓慢的方式进行？输入“HotWings”设计，只需使用“Hotwings”独有的 SupraSoaker 飞越您需要“涂漆”的区域，然后选择 Quicksell 销售点。**SupraSoaker 排放的警告液体可能易燃，请勿受热，编者注（不供公众观看）：PR 说这听起来很酷。特质：陆空机甲部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Whats to say about his mech, just another pointless custom design commander, who thought a... rotary? fluid gun was a good idea on a LAM? , well the nozzles rotate.. does that even count as rotary commander? Maybe you can find a good use for this mech
column2: 怎么说他的机甲，只是另一个毫无意义的定制设计指挥官，谁想到了……旋转？液体枪在 LAM 上是个好主意吗？ ，好吧，喷嘴旋转……这算不算旋转指挥官？也许你能找到这个机甲的好用处

column1: ntroducing the Quicsell Wolfhound – Chemical Carnage, Laser Defense! This specialized variant features an exclusively chemical arsenal with Quicsell's cutting-edge laser AMS. Embrace the lightened structure for nimble maneuvers on the battlefield. Unleash the full power of chemical lasers and trust Quicsell's laser AMS to keep you protected. The Quicsell Wolfhound: Where agility meets chemical mayhem! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell 猎狼犬 – 化学屠杀、激光防御！这种特殊的变体具有独特的化学武器库和 Quicsell 的尖端激光 AMS。采用轻型结构，在战场上灵活机动。释放化学激光器的全部威力，相信 Quicsell 的激光 AMS 可以为您提供保护。 Quicsell 猎狼犬：敏捷与化学混乱的结合！特质：Quicsell氏族机甲部署费用倍率：0.98手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Boss, they're selling this Quicsell Wolfhound – all chemical lasers and a fancy laser AMS. Lightened structure for agility, sure, but chemical lasers mean you're playing with volatile ammo. And that laser AMS? It sounds like a lot of glitz for a Wolfhound. I'd be cautious – chemical carnage might just turn into a Mech meltdown when you least expect it. Flashy promises, but I'm not sold on the practicality.
column2: 老板，他们正在出售这款 Quicsell Wolfhound - 全化学激光器和精美的激光 AMS。当然，减轻结构可以提高灵活性，但化学激光器意味着你使用的是挥发性弹药。那激光 AMS 呢？对于猎狼犬来说，这听起来很浮华。我会很谨慎——化学屠杀可能会在你最意想不到的时候变成机械崩溃。华而不实的承诺，但我并不相信其实用性。

column1: As you complete the buy order, Yang eyes the new acquisitions with a raised brow. "Well, Commander, we've got a bundle of cheap parts here, all wrapped up to make it seem like a fair deal. Managed to snag a single light mech in the mix, but let's not kid ourselves – we probably lost some serious C-Bills on this one. And take a look at these – they're all as flimsy as a paper tiger. We'll have our work cut out for us in the Mech Bay, that's for sure."
column2: 当你完成购买订单时，杨扬起眉毛看着新收购的产品。 “好吧，指挥官，我们这里有一堆便宜的零件，全部都包裹起来，看起来像是一笔公平的交易。设法在混合中抓住了一个轻型机甲，但我们别自欺欺人了——我们可能在这件事情上损失了一些严重的信用票据。看看这些——它们都像纸老虎一样脆弱。我们在机甲湾的工作会很困难，这是肯定的。”

"I mean, if we decide to scrap the things, we might break even, but I'm just amazed we ended up with mechs and equipment at all. They even included those extra parts they said they would. I would have put money on it just being a scam."
column2: 当你和杨走过大厅时，刚刚检查了你们的新机甲和设备，杨用他的机械手疯狂地做了手势。 “我的意思是，如果我们决定报废这些东西，我们可能会收支平衡，但我只是惊讶我们最终得到了机甲和设备。他们甚至包括了他们所说的那些额外零件。我愿意把钱押在这只是一个骗局。”

column1: As you and Yang stride down the corridor, the glow of satisfaction on Yang's face is hard to miss. "Commander, we hit the jackpot this time! A light mech, a solid medium-to-assault mech – I'm genuinely pleased. Sure, that small mech they tossed in is still on the flimsy side, but beggars can't be choosers, eh?" \n\n He waves his robotic hand theatrically. "And look at this haul – the usual assortment of Quicsell gear, and would you believe it? Some actual Clan equipment for our mechs. Now, that's what I call a successful deal. Looks like Quicsell might have redeemed themselves this round."
column2: 当你和杨大步走下走廊时，很难忽视杨脸上洋溢着满足的光芒。 “指挥官，这次我们中奖了！轻型机甲，坚固的中型攻击机甲，我实在是太高兴了。当然，他们扔来的那个小机甲虽然还很脆弱，但乞丐也不能挑三拣四吧？”\n他戏剧性地挥舞着他的机器人手。 “看看这批货物——常见的奎塞尔装备分类，你相信吗？一些适合我们机甲的实际部落装备。现在，这就是我所说的成功交易。看起来奎塞尔可能在这一轮中救赎了自己。”

column1:
As you and Yang make your way down the hallway, the disappointment on Yang's face is palpable. "Commander, I can't believe it. We got played. Look at this – just a massive crate filled with standard Quicsell equipment. Stacks and stacks of the same old stuff. This is nothing short of a scam." 

  He clenches his fists, the anger evident. "I should've known better. We've been had. The only thing they delivered on was disappointment. I'll be in the Mech Bay, figuring out what we can salvage from this sorry excuse of a deal. 

 Later, a communication from Quicsell arrives, claiming it was an 'error' , and as a 'good faith' gesture, they've issued a refund, giving you back half your hard-earned C-Bills. Yang snorts, muttering something about "good faith" in air quotes, but at least it's a silver lining in this otherwise grim deal."
column2: 当你和杨沿着走廊走时，杨脸上的失望之情显而易见。 “指挥官，我简直不敢相信。我们被玩了。看看这个——只是一个巨大的板条箱，里面装满了标准的Quicsell设备。一堆又一堆同样的旧东西。这简直就是一个骗局。”\n他握紧拳头，愤怒之情显而易见。 “我早该知道的。我们已经被骗了。他们唯一带来的就是失望。我会在机甲湾，弄清楚我们可以从这个令人遗憾的交易借口中挽救什么。\n后来，来自Quicsell的通信到达，声称这是一个“错误”，作为一种“善意”的姿态，他们已经退款，退还你辛苦赚来的一半的信用票据。杨哼了一声，在空中引用了一些关于“诚信”的内容，但至少这是这场原本严峻的交易中的一线希望。”

column1:
Darius knocks on your door, catching your attention. "Hey commander, I was going through open local mercenary contracts when I got a message that had a blank recipient line. It looks kind of dodgy, but, well... See for yourself " 

You take a look at the message, which reads: "Dear Sir/Madam, are you in the market for a reliable used mech, but don't have time to come and put it through it's paces? Let me tell you about this gem that fell off the back of a dropship. It's a later model Quicsell mech of high tonnage and low mileage, and I can assure you it's in excellent condition. It's a steal at the price I'm offering, and it won't be available for long. I can even have it delivered right to your dropship, and will include some extra spare parts and assorted Quicsell merchandise free of charge. So what do you say, are you ready to start tuning your new ride?" 

You turn a skeptical eye towards Darius, trying to convey your thoughts, but he continues on. "Look, I know, alright? But I ran the numbers, and if there really is a mech in there, we'll nearly break even just by selling the thing if we don't like the look of it. I figured I'd bring it to your attention at least."
column2: 大流士敲你的门，引起了你的注意。 “嘿，指挥官，我正在查看公开的当地雇佣兵合同，这时我收到一条消息，收件人行是空白的。这看起来有点狡猾，但是，好吧……你自己看看”\r\n你看看这条消息，上面写着：“亲爱的先生/女士，您是否在市场上寻找可靠的二手机甲，但没有时间来测试它？让我告诉您这颗从背面掉落的宝石的故事这是一艘高吨位、低里程的新型 Quicsell 机甲，我可以向您保证，以我提供的价格来说，它很便宜，而且我什至可以将其直接交付给您，并且会免费提供一些额外的备件和各种 Quicsell 商品，那么您准备好开始调整您的新座驾了吗？”\r\n你将怀疑的目光转向Darius，试图传达你的想法，但他继续说道。 “听着，我知道，好吗？但我算了一下数字，如果里面真的有一个机甲，如果我们不喜欢它的外观，我们只要卖掉它就几乎可以收支平衡。我想我至少会让你注意到它。”

column2: REX 激光器，战场之王！ Quicksell 革命性的重新设计的 X 脉冲激光器具有重新设计的激光器和臭名昭著的 X 脉冲技术的所有优点！调整为撕裂装甲，但对机甲内部造成的损害很小

column1: Designed by Clan Coyote in 3068 as a way to integrate the Advanced Tactical Missile System on ProtoMechs. While many sacrifices had to be made to fit it on Protomechs. While it can use any type of ATM and IATM ammo but it only carries a single reload.
column2: 由 Clan Coyote 在 3068 年设计，作为在 ProtoMech 上集成先进战术导弹系统的一种方式。虽然必须做出许多牺牲才能将其安装到 Protomechs 上。虽然它可以使用任何类型的 ATM 和 IATM 弹药，但它只能进行一次装弹。

column1: We here at QuickSell know you're looking for the best weapons out there. And we hear you! Boy, those Battlearmor and infantry are annoying, right? So we came up with hollow-point plasma cartridges, providing the *oomph* of a hollow-point, with the *sizzle* of Plasma. You might say that's totally insane, but we find that the hollow-point design helps to spread the plasma around, turning a single ball of burny, into many balls of you-should-have-stayed-home!* *Warning: Firing non-lased hollow-point plasma cartridges constitutes a war crime according to the updated Ares convention of 3298. Always excite your cartridges, and we mean with lasers. \n\nUses Plasma Ammo. VOLATILE!
column2: QuickSell 知道您正在寻找最好的武器。我们听到你的声音了！小子，那些战甲和步兵很烦人吧？因此，我们想出了空心等离子墨盒，提供空心点的“魅力”和等离子的“嘶嘶声”。你可能会说这完全是疯狂的，但我们发现空心设计有助于扩散等离子，将单个燃烧球变成许多你应该待在家里的球！**警告：根据更新的 3298 战神公约，发射非激光空心等离子弹药筒构成战争罪。始终激发你的弹药筒，我们指的是用激光。使用等离子弹药。易失！
